svg.title: Proof. A boundary type has a number of preimages under folding independent of j; the interior type has 2(w−2r+1)+2j preimages. A four-coordinate type therefore has multiplicity a product of four constant or affine functions of j. The fourth finite difference P j(1, −4, 6, −4, 1)jg(j) annihilates polynomials of degree below four, hence every product with a constant factor, and on the product of four interior factors, whose leading term is 24j4, it equals 4! 24. Faces and edges of every codimension are included.
